in_marathi.name: Bhati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhaga', which refers to the Hindu god of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name symbolizes abundance, riches, and material success.
